verdict.line: You lose if you facetank poison poke from levels 1-5 without punishing his autos; you win from level 6 onward once Q into R turns into a kill threat.

brief.thesis: Teemo's poke is almost entirely auto-attack based (Toxic Shot) and his only disable is a blind, which does nothing to Malphite's ability-based damage — so Granite Shield and E eat most of his pressure while Malphite still threatens a hard engage. That asymmetry is why Malphite holds the measured 51% win rate and a solo-kill edge over 3,212 games despite Teemo controlling lane tempo early.

theirWindow.when: Q (Blinding Dart) is up, you're exposed
theirWindow.what: He'll blind you to land free autos and poison stacks risk-free — don't walk up for an auto-trade here, but your Q/E/R still work fine through the blind.

yourWindow.what: Use Q (Seismic Shard) to steal his movement speed and close the gap, then R (Unstoppable Force) immediately — Teemo has no hard escape and this combo kills him per the matchup data.

start.why: The 84.6%-pick, 51%-winrate start — the mana and sustain let you keep answering his poke with Q/E instead of running dry early.

boots.why: 52% win rate over 1,799 games; the magic resist and tenacity cut both his poison DoT and any mushroom slow he lands near river or brush.

core.why: The 56.2%-winrate core opener — lower cooldowns and magic pen keep Q/E up more often than Teemo can reset his poke.
Burst magic damage that makes your R engage a real kill threat on Teemo's low base HP, not just a knockup.
Bonus damage to lowered-health targets finishes Teemo off once Toxic Shot stacks or your combo has chipped him down.

situational.when: their poison and DoT ticks are adding up fast across the team
you're facing multiple AP burst threats beyond just Teemo
their frontline is stacking healing or lifesteal
a physical attack-speed carry is snowballing on their side

runes.keystoneWhy: Comet triggers off Q (Seismic Shard) or E (Ground Slam) landing, giving you extra ranged poke damage to actually answer Teemo's own poke instead of just absorbing it — matches the higher-winrate (51.7%) page.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite has the higher measured win rate (51.9% over 37.7% pick) and the burn secures the level-6 all-in kill window on Teemo's low HP pool; Flash+Teleport (50.4%, highest pick rate at 60.8%) is the safer pick if you want wave and roam flexibility instead.

playing.title: Trade only after shield recharges
playing.detail: Granite Shield (passive) recharges when Malphite hasn't been hit recently — let a lull in his poke pass before stepping up, or you're trading HP into a shield-less body.

playing.title: Abilities ignore his blind
playing.detail: Blinding Dart (Q) only blinds autoattacks, not spells — your Q, E and R all still land and deal full damage, so don't play passive just because you're blinded.

playing.title: Ground Slam cuts his poke DPS
playing.detail: E (Ground Slam) reduces attack speed for a short duration, directly cutting into Toxic Shot's (E) damage output during an extended trade — use it the moment he commits to auto-attacking.

playing.title: Hunt the level 6 kill
playing.detail: Use Q (Seismic Shard) to steal his movement speed and close distance, then R (Unstoppable Force) the instant you hit level 6 — he has no hard escape and dies to the combo.

playing.title: Respect mushroom zones near brush
playing.detail: Noxious Trap (R) has only a 1s cooldown, so he seeds mushrooms cheaply around river and tribrush — check for vision before dashing in with an R engage.

playing.title: Punish camouflage re-engages
playing.detail: Leaving stealth gives him a brief attack-speed buff (Element of Surprise) — if he's been standing still in a bush, back off rather than walk into an ambush reset.

playing.title: Itemize armor for free E damage
playing.detail: Ground Slam's damage scales with your Armor, so every armor piece in your build is also raw damage against Teemo — building tanky never stops you from threatening him in skirmishes.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners and the win-rate/sample numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch (OP.GG); the mechanical reasoning and trade timings are my own read of the kit interactions, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Although it is difficult to gain lane control from Teemo during early game, use [Q] to contest often to kill him with [R] upon reaching level 6.
